SEARCH
Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api
Package persistence.tools.spi

Interface EnhancerProvider

All Superinterfaces:
PersistenceServiceProvider
public interface EnhancerProvider extends PersistenceServiceProvider
Service-provider interface for obtaining a namespace-specific Enhancer.

Implementations are discovered at runtime via ServiceLoader. The convenience methods getEnhancerProvider(String), getEnhancerProvider(String, ClassLoader), and getEnhancerProvider(String, ModuleLayer) map a JPA specification version to the correct provider across standard, custom classloader, or modular ModuleLayer runtime environments.

In JPMS environments, provider modules register their implementation with provides persistence.tools.spi.EnhancerProvider in module-info.java.

Since:
4.0.0
